question: Can a low-degree-of-freedom delta-neutral spot-perpetual carry baseline be reconstructed from same-venue official historical data without mixing venues or using current-survivor assumptions?

mechanism.purpose: isolate funding/basis carry rather than directional crypto beta
mechanism.positive_funding_cashflow: short perpetual receives positive funding while long spot offsets first-order price exposure
mechanism.negative_funding_cashflow: the baseline would not be assumed profitable; 0030 does not define a trading rule or inspect PNL

primary_data_source.reason: official public archives expose same-venue spot 1d klines, USD-M perpetual 1d klines and USD-M fundingRate history with long historical coverage

required_checks: discover monthly archive objects from official Binance public-data S3 listing rather than assuming current symbols
record first/last month and internal month gaps for spot, perpetual and funding separately
parse representative first/middle/last objects for all three datasets
construct the common monthly coverage intersection for each asset
verify spot and perpetual daily timestamps can be aligned on completed UTC days within common coverage
report missing daily bars and clustered archive gaps without interpolation
report funding settlement event count, sign distribution and observed interval distribution within common coverage
compute contemporaneous diagnostic basis = perp_close / spot_close - 1 only as a data diagnostic; no strategy PNL or entry/exit optimization
retain source-specific limitations and do not substitute Hyperliquid or other venues into missing Binance fields
required_outputs: per-asset archive coverage table for spot/perp/funding
funding event coverage and sign/interval diagnostics

pass_rule.no_unresolved_held_position_concept: not applicable because this is a data-only audit
pass_rule.decision: PASS authorizes a separately preregistered naive delta-neutral carry PNL experiment; FAIL blocks carry PNL until the data defect is resolved

prohibited: no current API/current-survivor substitution for historical existence
no interpolation or forward-fill across missing official daily bars
no asset-specific exception chosen after seeing economics
